nodes.question: Why is education considered essential in addressing the global environmental crisis according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Education is essential for fostering the political and economic transformation needed to tackle issues such as climate change, pollution, and biodiversity loss.
nodes.paragraph: This opens different pros - pects for the use of learning gardens in the training of pre-service teachers. Keywords Pre-service teachers School gardens Learning gardens Connectedness to nature Environmental concernAccepted: 24 February 2025 The Author(s) 2025Connectedness to nature: assessing the impact of garden- based learning on teacher education Diego Corrochano Fern ndez1 Alejandro G mez-Gon alves1 Sara Serrate Gonz lez1 Jos Manuel Mu OZ Rodr guez1 Diego Corrochano Fern ndez dcf@usal.es Alejandro G mez-Gon alves algomez@usal.es Sara Serrate Gonz lez sarasg@usal.es Jos Manuel Mu OZ Rodr guez pepema@usal.es 1 Universidad de Salamanca, Salamanca, Spain 13 Journal of Outdoor and Environmental EducationIntroduction The planet is facing a global environmental crisis that is mainly linked to the effects of climate change, pollution, and biodiversity loss. To ensure a sustainable future requires a joint and systematic approach to these problems. In this regard, educa - tion is essential to the political and economic transformation that is needed (Baste et al., 2021 ). Despite the efforts engaged in over the last decades, education for sus - tainability and environmental education as genuine training for sustainable devel - opment still require improvement, since the future of our environment depends on the decisions made by future generations (Murga-Menoyo, 2021 ).
